whatsNew.title: What Changed from 2025–26
content: The traditional calendar starts August 24 in 2026–27, 20 calendar days later than August 4 in 2025–26.
The last day of school is May 26, eight calendar days later than May 18 in 2025–26. Students will be dismissed early on May 26.
The 2026–27 traditional calendar does not include a multi-day October Fall Break; the 2025–26 calendar included an October 13–17 Fall Break.

calendarFaqs.q: Do all JCPS kindergarten students start on August 24?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The traditional calendar lists August 24 as the first day for most students, but kindergarten uses staggered entry on August 26–27. All kindergarten students attend on August 28. Families should check with their child’s school for their assigned staggered-entry day.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 11, 2026 using Johnston County Public Schools’ adopted 2026–27 traditional student calendar, official kindergarten event listings, and the separate ECA and CTLA calendar.
sourceReviewDetails: Checked the first and last day, break ranges, no-school days, early dismissals, quarter endings, and January return date against the adopted JCPS traditional student calendar.
Confirmed kindergarten staggered entry on August 26–27 and the August 28 start for all kindergarten students in the official JCPS events calendar.
Kept the ECA and CTLA calendar separate because those students do not follow every date on the traditional calendar.
Thanksgiving Day, New Year’s Day, and Good Friday fall within published break ranges and are not repeated as separate calendar rows.
